gloss: to move and settle; to migrate

definitions.gloss: to move to a new place and settle there; to migrate
definitions.explanation: To leave one place and make one's home in another, usually for good: a family moving to the countryside, people emigrating abroad, animals settling in a new habitat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{移|うつ}り{住|す}んだ。
examples.english: We moved to the countryside to live.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：32850_koro⟧⟦ブラジル→ブラジル：31001_burajiru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{移|うつ}り{住|す}んだ。
examples.english: My grandfather emigrated to Brazil when he was young.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{移|うつ}り{住|す}む⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧、⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{活気|かっき}→活気：02554_kakki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧きた。
examples.english: With more young people moving in from the cities, the town has come back to life.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{移|うつ}る→移る：01232_utsuru⟧ (to move) and ⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧ (to live): the stress is on settling, not on the move itself.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [place]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{移|うつ}り{住|す}む: to move to [place] and live there
- [place]⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{移|うつ}り{住|す}む: to come to live from [place]

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧: to move house — the everyday word for the act of moving
- ⟦{移住|いじゅう}する→移住する：17190_ijuusuru⟧: to migrate — the formal Sino-Japanese equivalent
